    A Capsis script to run Hisafe simulation in BATCH MODE DOS command example to run the script capsis -p script safe.pgms.ScriptGen C:/Projets/capsis4/data/safe/simSettings/exemple/exemple.sim Read the sim file Create output folder Open an existing project with projectFileName or create a new one Load export file Load weather file Load LAI forcing file Create output session.txt Run the simulation Save project if option is activated
